note: Newer small private RV park a mile west of Syracuse on gravel J Road, on a bench above the Little Nemaha River. Gravel back-in sites with picnic table and fire pit; portable restroom; community fire pit at 'The Point'; river access by a ramp and a sandbar beach. Dump station at Love's on Hwy 2 (~1 mi, $10 or less). Daily, weekly and monthly rates. --Claude
summary: The operator's site confirms 14 back-in RV sites (60-65 ft) with 50/30/20 A electric, two water hydrants, no sewer and no dump on site (Love's ~1 mi), walk-in tent areas, and Firefly online booking; all written. Price indicator is RV Life $$ only: the Firefly engine needs a search behind a reCAPTCHA, which isn't automated. Presence: working website + phone; Google 4.9 from 24. Not waterfront kept: the river (~12 m wide, creek class) bends round the loop but the pads face inward from the loop road with ~30-70 m and a tree line to the bank.
flags: WATERFRONT not waterfront KEPT (operator claim 'overlooks the river' / 'on the edge of the Little Nemaha River' triggered the gate): imagery shows the Little Nemaha ~10-14 m wide (creek class under the ~30 m line), looping past the campground's NE and N sides. The east-side pads point inward from the gravel loop road, so the road lies between them and the water, and the bank is ~30-35 m beyond it behind a strip of trees. The north pads are ~60-70 m from the bank across grass and a brush/tree band. Nothing qualifies as creekside, and there is no creek-view value.

PRICE: no posted rate on the operator site; Firefly shows rates only after a date search (reCAPTCHA, not automated per the README). RV Life $$ (stored) is the price indicator. A human could read a 1-night quote on the Firefly link.

GATE FACTS: website https://www.littleriversedge.com/ with phone 402-413-1594 (matches stored); Google 4.9 from 24 reviews (under 25, so no review-count presence; the website + phone suffice); a 2026 review: 'A new park with electric hookups and a community water source. No dumping or wifi available.' Owner replies to reviews.

LONG-STAY (five tests): rules say 'LRE is a daily rate campground'; daily, weekly and monthly rates and a Firefly 'Ongoing - Pay monthly' type exist, and a floodplain ordinance caps RVs at under 180 consecutive days. Nightly online booking with a 24-hour cancellation rule; no residents described in reviews read. Not long-stay in character.
PIN OK: stored 40.6542,-96.2093 is in the middle of the gravel loop; Google's point (40.653674,-96.2095458) is at the entrance ~60 m south.
Restrooms: only a 'Portable restroom facility'; no showers mentioned. Not written.
